findings.detail: Option D reuses a wrong option from earlier question M2-S52-T1. The earlier option enabled strict mode on the findings JSON schema so the model can no longer produce malformed output. Option D only turns this into a cause: the finding schema lacks strict mode, so malformed findings hide the patterns. Option C is also close to the earlier wrong option about the model's own confidence score per finding.

blind_answer.reason: Per 4.4-K3/S3, findings need a detected_pattern field that records the source construct that triggered them. Without it, dismissals cannot be grouped by triggering pattern to analyze false positives. Batch ordering is handled via custom_id, confidence scores do not identify constructs, and strict mode only addresses syntax errors.
